evidence.title: Fresh Housing Schemes to be Offered by PDA in Areas That Were Upgraded for Maha Kumbh
evidence.property_name: Fresh Housing Schemes to be Offered by PDA in Areas That Were Upgraded for Maha Kumbh
evidence.description: Vice Chairman, Amit Pal Sharma said, "With a number of developmental works, several localities in the city have now become more beautiful and equipped with all amenities. They are the most ‘sought-after' areas for people to own a house. To fulfil their wish, we are identifying land that either belongs to us or can be procured for housing schemes and plots." For the uniformed, the areas where the upcoming housing schemes might be launched by the PDA include the inner ring road, locality near the Prayagraj Airport at Jhalwa, as well as the areas that will become accessible after the completion of the six lane bridge over the Ganga. [...] Sources also said that the PDA could also develop fresh residential schemes around the Airport Road that goes towards Jhalwa in the coming months. There is scope for 300 flats and more than 400 plots that could be carved out for the said residential scheme. For this, the PDA is planning to buy 150 to 200 hectares of land. Regarding this, the VC said, "We have started identifying all the land that belongs to us and freeing the same from any encroachment or any legal issue associated with it. After proper verification, it will be included in our land bank and will be used for residential and commercial purposes in the future."
